question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

They waited with __anxiety__ for the final results.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"anxiety"** means a feeling of worry, nervousness, or unease about something with an uncertain outcome. (चिंता)

 
 
• **Example: **She felt a surge of **anxiety** as the deadline approached.
 
 
 
• **"Calmness"** refers to the state of being free from agitation, excitement, or disturbance; it is the opposite of anxiety. (शांति)
 
 
• **Example: **His **calmness** during the crisis helped everyone stay focused.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'anxiety'** is **'calmness'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Shrewdness** (चतुराई): The quality of having or showing good powers of judgement.

 
 
• **Example:** His **shrewdness** in business matters is well-known.
 
 
 
• **Wilderness** (जंगली इलाका): An uncultivated, uninhabited, and inhospitable region.
 
 
• **Example: **They ventured deep into the** wilderness **for their camping trip.
 
 
 
• **Feebleness** (निर्बलता): The quality of being weak or lacking in strength.
 
 
• **Example:** His** feebleness **was evident after his long illness.
